style.vernacular: Capital of Jigawa State since 1991, built around the walled Garu emir palace and the granite Dutse hills. Old quarters are Hausa mud-render compounds with entrance halls (zaure) and flat roofs; the newer government areas are planned zones (Three-Arm Zone) of 2-4 storey cream rendered blocks, with shop rows under metal sheets, on red laterite earth and neem shade trees.
style.ornament: Hausa-Fulani palace motifs: geometric relief on gatehouses and parapets, arched entrance halls, low pinnacled parapets. Dutse means rock, and granite boulders are everywhere.
